Crash sites: scripts/i601_phase0_reads.py:114 (r_map comprehension, KeyError before any gate), scripts/i601_dense_read.py:156-158 (fail-loud raise), so the production launch dies at Phase 0 on a provisioned 4xH100 pod (#504 incident class). Fix: constrain bystander selection to held_out ∩ r_eval coverage (record exclusions in bystander_panel.json), and either regenerate frozen R for the missing parent negatives or descope c472_near/c472_negp_8 TF reads with an explicit coverage check at selection time. Also reconcile why HF issue472_neg_geometry persona_bank.json and R_*.json disagree (45/60 overlap) - the pinned parent artifact pair is mutually inconsistent.

summary: i601_analyze classifies the anchor arm from the parent re-read even when anchor_reuse_ok=false and the retrain fallback fired; plan §4 item 3 requires the fallback cells to replace the arm.
evidence: scripts/i601_analyze.py:156-172 unconditionally builds the 'anchor' arm terminals from phase0/onpolicy_recheck/c472_anchor_seed{42,137}/trajectory.json. When the Phase-0 fitness gate fails (anchor_reuse_ok=false) and the dispatcher's --anchor-retrain-fallback trains dense_200p800n seed 42 (+137 via Phase 2), the analyzer has no branch substituting those fresh cells as the middle fixed-ratio arm - the pre-registered phase1.call would be computed against the UNFIT parent adapters with only a top-level anchor_reuse_ok flag adjacent. Fix: when (gate or {}).get('anchor_reuse_ok') is False, source the anchor terminals from phase2/dense_200p800n_seed*/trajectory.json terminal source_self instead.
